newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's NHK to list two companies on JSE.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's NHK to list two companies on JSE.

text.p: South Africa's NHK Investements said on Thursday it would list two companies on the Johannesburg Stock exchange from the second quarter of this year.

NHK Investments -- a holding group for food franchising, property and development companies -- said its Kairinos Foods Ltd unit would list in the second quarter of 1997 with a total capitalisation of 500 million rand.
NHK said it planned to shortly change its name to Kairinos Investments Ltd.

The other firm being listed is Nucleus Property Holdings with a portfolio close to a billion rand. Follwoinga succesful flotation it will be the largest listed property holding company in the country, the firm said.
Kairinos has close to 400 company-owned and franchise outlets country-wide and brands include Mochachos Chicken Villages, Ocean Basket, Java Coast Coffee and I Can't Believe Its Yogurt.

"We believe we have put together a unique organisation. We have retained the strengths of the food franchising business, namely full personal involvement, with the strengths that an internationally connected group such as ours can bring to the table," executive chairman Nick Kairinos said in a statement.
